niche: a New Zealand member-owned bank's business support unit choosing which two watch-list borrowers get its 2027 support packages by the credit write-off each package keeps off the bank's book, when some of the bank's smaller business borrowers take most of their receipts from one watch-list firm through payments the bank itself processes
answer: Kinloch Engineering and Matai Valley Foods, NZ$3,350,000 of 2027 write-off kept off the book
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every field and rule correctly sums each watch-list borrower's IFRS 9 twelve-month PD x LGD x EAD from the bank's validated run and gives the two packages to the two largest (Ends on: Kinloch Engineering and Ridgeway Precast, NZ$3.0 million kept off the book), missing the write-off a package to Matai Valley Foods also keeps off the borrowers in the book that take most of their receipts from it.
domain_test: Write-off a support package prevents is an expected credit loss computation (PD x LGD x EAD) with one obligor's 2027 default averted and the dependent obligors' default chance conditioned on it, read from the bank's own record of defaults following a main payer's default; with another field's nouns there is no loss given default, no exposure at default and no trade dependence carrying one firm's default to its suppliers, so the task stops reading the same.

spine.entity: one posted transaction on a business customer's transaction account

world.org_type: a member-owned bank with a business lending book and its borrowers' transaction accounts

driver: The decisive quantity is what preventing one unit's failure removes across a population of units, when some units draw most of their inflow from that unit and in the population's own record failed at a high rate within months of their main payer's failure, so a value read on the unit's own expected loss misses the failures it would set off; the dependence comes from the flows between units and the conditional failure rate from the population's past failures, neither stored in any field.
driver_concrete: A business support package that keeps a watch-list borrower out of default in 2027 also keeps out of default the Ruahine borrowers that take most of their receipts from it, which in the bank's 2021 to 2026 record defaulted far more often within twelve months of their main payer's default than otherwise; a package's prevented write-off is the borrower's own PD x LGD x EAD plus its PD times that uplift times each dependent's LGD x EAD, with dependence read from the on-us payments.
stump: A competent solver values each package at the supported borrower's own 2027 expected write-off from the IFRS 9 run and gives the two packages to Kinloch Engineering and Ridgeway Precast, when Matai Valley Foods pays most of the receipts of several borrowers in the book whose defaults followed their main payer's in the bank's own record, so a package there keeps more write-off off the book than one at Ridgeway.

differentiation.task482: task482 v11 re-estimates a group's share from its members' own sparse answers instead of imputations from a population model; here nothing is imputed: the decisive move adds to one unit's own expected loss the failures its survival prevents among other units that draw most of their inflow from it, read from flows between units and their past failures

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a forward total projected from a history of cumulative progress by age in which the units carrying most of the amount began resolving more slowly partway through the record; the share of the amount settled tracks the share of units resolved rather than age, so the history has to be restated at the resolution shares the latest observations show before its age-to-age ratios are carried forward, and carrying them unrestated, or taking them from the latest periods alone, understates the total.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the part of each unit's recorded wait that the offered intervention removes, because the recorded wait fuses the step the intervention replaces with a concurrent step it leaves in place, so only the replaced step's excess over the concurrent one, built by joining separate operational logs, counts; ranking units by the recorded wait, or by the replaced step measured from the same start, credits the units whose concurrent step is slowest.
